definitions.short: properly, to roil water ; figuratively, to disturb or affict
definitions.full: H5916. akar עָכַר verb stir up, disturb, trouble (Late Hebrew id., make turbid ; Arabic be turbid ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ע 1Sam 14:29 ; 2 masculine singular suffix עֲכַרְתָּ֔נִי Josh 7:25 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יַעְכָּרְךָ 7:25 ; Participle עֹכֵר 1Kin 18:17 3 t., עוֺכֵר 1Chr 2:7 ; plural suffix עֹכְרָ֑י Judg 11:35 ; — disturb, trouble , with accusative of person Gen 34:30 (J), Josh 6:18 ; 7:25 (twice in verse) (all J E; 7:25 b subject ׳י ), Judg 11:35 ; compare Prov 11:17 (opposed to גֹּמֵל ), 11:29 ; 15:27 (opposed to חָיָה ; ׳ע יִשְׂרָאֵל 1Kin 18:17-18 , 1Chr 2:7 (compare Josh 7:18 etc., above); ׳ע אֶתהָֿאָרֶץ 1Sam 14:29 . Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נֶעְכָּ֑ר וּכְאֵבִי Psa 39:3 my pain was stirred up ; Participle feminine נֶעְכָּ֑רֶת Prov 15:6 usually as abstract noun disturbance, calamity , but < read רָשָׁע וּתְבוּאַת [ ה ] נִכְרָ֑ת the income of the wicked is cut off (Toy).
